subject: design/config-driven-portability-v1
statement: the target-facing doc paths not yet represented in the schema are added as keys under the existing closed path schema, and the git remote is added as a top-level scalar beside the existing branch scalar — deliberate closed-schema keys, each with its current value as the default (`design-brainstorm:…#D-2`; INV-32). No new configuration surface is introduced (the single system config is settled — `design:installer-v1`, its D-7).
